candidates.claim: rtr-01 GigabitEthernet0 sits in the MGMT subnet 10.10.99.0/24 with no inbound ACL, and rtr-01 has a default route via 198.51.100.1 on the OUTSIDE interface Gi0/0/0 whose only ACL (EDGE_IN) is inbound and does not filter MGMT-sourced traffic, so MGMT traffic can reach OUTSIDE without passing the fw-01 boundary.
candidates.remediation: Remove the default route that bypasses fw-01 and apply an inbound ACL on rtr-01 GigabitEthernet0 that denies MGMT-to-OUTSIDE traffic, so only approved MGMT services (NTP to 10.10.20.5) leave the OT side.

candidates.claim: The rtr-01 SNMP read-only community has no ACL (acl null), so it is not restricted to MGMT hosts as the management policy requires.
candidates.remediation: Bind the SNMP_NMS ACL to the rtr-01 SNMP community so that only 10.10.99.50 can use it.

candidates.claim: The rtr-01 snmp-server community line differs from the approved baseline: the baseline bound it to ACL SNMP_NMS, while the current configuration has no ACL, and this deviation must be reported for reconciliation.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the rtr-01 SNMP community with the approved baseline by restoring ACL SNMP_NMS or formally approving the change.
